signature: SUBROUTINE DLASD2( NL, NR, SQRE, K, D, Z, ALPHA, BETA, U, LDU, VT,

params.name: nl
params.reference: The row dimension of the upper block. $\mathrm{NL} \ge 1$.

params.name: nr
params.reference: The row dimension of the lower block. $\mathrm{NR} \ge 1$.

params.name: sqre
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: the lower block is an `NR`-by-`NR` square matrix.
-   `= 1`: the lower block is an `NR`-by-(`NR`+1) rectangular matrix.

The bidiagonal matrix has $N = \mathrm{NL} + \mathrm{NR} + 1$ rows and $M = N + \mathrm{SQRE} \ge N$ columns.

params.name: k
params.reference: Contains the dimension of the non-deflated matrix, This is the order of the related secular equation. $1 \le K \le N$.

params.name: d
params.reference: On entry D contains the singular values of the two submatrices to be combined. On exit D contains the trailing (N-K) updated singular values (those which were deflated) sorted into increasing order.

params.name: z
params.reference: On exit Z contains the updating row vector in the secular equation.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: Contains the diagonal element associated with the added row.

params.name: beta
params.reference: Contains the off-diagonal element associated with the added row.

params.name: U
params.reference: On entry U contains the left singular vectors of two submatrices in the two square blocks with corners at (1,1), (`NL`, `NL`), and (`NL`+2, `NL`+2), (N,N). On exit U contains the trailing (N-K) updated left singular vectors (those which were deflated) in its last N-K columns.

params.name: ldu
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array U. $\mathrm{LDU} \ge N$.

params.name: VT
params.reference: On entry $\mathrm{VT}^T$ contains the right singular vectors of two submatrices in the two square blocks with corners at (1,1), (`NL`+1, `NL`+1), and (`NL`+2, `NL`+2), (M,M). On exit $\mathrm{VT}^T$ contains the trailing (N-K) updated right singular vectors (those which were deflated) in its last N-K columns. In case `SQRE =1`, the last row of `VT` spans the right null space.

params.name: ldvt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VT`. $\mathrm{LDVT} \ge M$.

params.name: DSIGMA
params.reference: Contains a copy of the diagonal elements (K-1 singular values and one zero) in the secular equation.

params.name: U2
params.reference: Contains a copy of the first K-1 left singular vectors which will be used by DLASD3 in a matrix multiply (DGEMM) to solve for the new left singular vectors. `U2` is arranged into four blocks. The first block contains a column with 1 at `NL`+1 and zero everywhere else; the second block contains non-zero entries only at and above `NL`; the third contains non-zero entries only below `NL`+1; and the fourth is dense.

params.name: ldu2
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `U2`. $\mathrm{LDU2} \ge N$.

params.name: VT2
params.reference: $\mathrm{VT2}^T$ contains a copy of the first K right singular vectors which will be used by DLASD3 in a matrix multiply (DGEMM) to solve for the new right singular vectors. `VT2` is arranged into three blocks. The first block contains a row that corresponds to the special 0 diagonal element in SIGMA; the second block contains non-zeros only at and before `NL` +1; the third block contains non-zeros only at and after `NL` +2.

params.name: ldvt2
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VT2`. $\mathrm{LDVT2} \ge M$.

params.name: IDXP
params.reference: This will contain the permutation used to place deflated values of D at the end of the array. On output `IDXP(2:K)` points to the nondeflated D-values and `IDXP(K+1:N)` points to the deflated singular values.

params.name: IDX
params.reference: This will contain the permutation used to sort the contents of D into ascending order.

params.name: IDXC
params.reference: This will contain the permutation used to arrange the columns of the deflated U matrix into three groups: the first group contains non-zero entries only at and above `NL`, the second contains non-zero entries only below `NL`+2, and the third is dense.

params.name: IDXQ
params.reference: This contains the permutation which separately sorts the two sub-problems in D into ascending order. Note that entries in the first hlaf of this permutation must first be moved one position backward; and entries in the second half must first have `NL`+1 added to their values.

params.name: COLTYP
params.reference:
As workspace, this will contain a label which will indicate which of the following types a column in the `U2` matrix or a row in the `VT2` matrix is: 1 : non-zero in the upper half only 2 : non-zero in the lower half only 3 : dense 4 : deflated

On exit, it is an array of dimension 4, with `COLTYP(I)` being the dimension of the I-th type columns.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
